summary_en: DENSO will cancel 400 million shares on November 30, 2026, reducing outstanding shares by 13.7%. The cancellation was approved by the board on October 29, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On October 29, 2026, DENSO's board of directors resolved to cancel 400 million treasury shares, effective November 30, 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares to be cancelled represent 13.7% of outstanding shares before cancellation. As of September 30, 2026, DENSO held 403.5 million treasury shares against 2.51 billion shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock).
